```{r}
esm2_raw <- data.table::fread(file.path(proj_dir, "data/revision/esm2/src_esm2_3b_fl.csv"))
```

```{r}
allo <- c(313, 314, 320 ,333, 376, 380 ,385, 386, 421, 433 ,436 ,444 ,449, 453 ,462, 465, 466,471, 474, 509 ,533,
          328 ,339, 340 ,348, 387 ,388, 406 ,408, 409 ,410 ,411, 412 ,419, 427 ,429 ,430 ,431 ,432 ,447, 450 ,457)

ortho <- c(277, 279, 281, 282, 284, 296, 298, 389, 391, 394, 396, 407, 428)

core_pos <- unique (df_ddg %>% filter (FL_folding_mean_kcal.mol >= 1) %>% pull(position.x))
core_pos

fit_residuals_loess <- function(df, y_col, x_col = "ddG_pred", exclude_pos = NULL, span = 0.7) {
df_fit <- df
if (!is.null(exclude_pos)) df_fit <- df_fit %>% filter(!Pos %in% exclude_pos)

f <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ ", x_col))
lo <- loess(f, data = df_fit, span = span, family = "symmetric")

fitted <- predict(lo, newdata = df)
resid  <- df[[y_col]] - fitted

list(loess = lo, fitted = fitted, residual = resid)
}

# ESM1v residuals

r1 <- fit_residuals_loess(test_merged_df, y_col = "ESM1v", exclude_pos = ortho, span = 0.7)
test_merged_df$fitted_esm1v <- r1$fitted
test_merged_df$resid_esm1v  <- r1$residual

# ESM2 residuals

r2 <- fit_residuals_loess(test_merged_df, y_col = "esm2", exclude_pos = ortho, span = 0.7)
test_merged_df$fitted_esm2 <- r2$fitted
test_merged_df$resid_esm2  <- r2$residual

sum(is.na(test_merged_df$resid_esm1v))
sum(is.na(test_merged_df$resid_esm2))

```
```{r}
test_merged_df
test_residue <- test_merged_df %>%
  group_by(Pos) %>%
  summarise(resid_median_esm1v = median(resid_esm1v, na.rm = TRUE),
            resid_median_esm2  = median(resid_esm2,  na.rm = TRUE),
            ddgb_median        = median(FL_activity_mean_kcal.mol,  na.rm = TRUE),
            esm1v_median       = median(ESM1v,       na.rm = TRUE),
            esm2_median        = median(esm2,        na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(site_type = case_when(Pos %in% ortho ~ "Binding site",
                               Pos %in% allo ~ "Allosteric site",
                               Pos %in% core_pos ~ "Core site",
                               TRUE                        ~ "Non-orthosteric site"))
```
```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
site_cols <- c(
"Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
"Allosteric site"      = "cyan",
"Binding site"         = "orange",
"Core site" = "red"
)
nrow(test_residue)
cor.test(test_residue$esm1v_median, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.67
cor.test(test_residue$esm2_median, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.58
cor.test(test_residue$resid_median_esm1v, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.62
cor.test(test_residue$resid_median_esm2, test_residue$ddgb_median, method="spearman") #-0.52

p6 <- ggplot(test_residue, aes(x = ddgb_median , y = esm1v_median, color = site_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "SRC",
    subtitle = "Spearman's rho = -0.67",
    x = "Experimental median ddGb",
    y = "Median ESM1v",
    color = "") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Non-orthosteric site" = "darkgreen",
    "Allosteric site" = "cyan",
    "Binding site" = "orange",
    "Core site" = "red"
  )) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey")
```
